techniques.name: Terminal/tool-output compression
techniques.intervention_surface: shell stdout/stderr and command output before model context
techniques.compatibility_rule: Do not double-wrap the same command stream with competing compactors.

techniques.name: Targeted code retrieval and representation
techniques.intervention_surface: source reads, symbol queries, repo maps, AST outlines
techniques.compatibility_rule: Choose one primary retrieval/index path per task to avoid duplicated context.

techniques.name: MCP/API response shaping
techniques.compatibility_rule: Layering field trimmers can remove required fields; version rules carefully.

techniques.name: Execution offload / code-mode sandboxing
techniques.intervention_surface: multi-step tool workflows executed outside main context
techniques.compatibility_rule: Stackable with retrieval/output tools, but generated code and sandbox summaries become trust boundaries.

techniques.name: Prompt/history/context compression
techniques.intervention_surface: conversation history, retrieved prose, logs, and prompts
techniques.compatibility_rule: Avoid multiple lossy compressors rewriting the same facts without raw fallback.

techniques.name: Persistent memory and reinjection
techniques.compatibility_rule: Multiple memory systems need one authority or deduplication policy.

techniques.name: Behavioral output compression
techniques.intervention_surface: model prose, narration, and status updates
techniques.compatibility_rule: Use one style controller; multiple terse prompts can harm clarity.

techniques.name: Artifact/code minimization
techniques.intervention_surface: generated source, docs, dependencies, and implementation scope
techniques.compatibility_rule: Usually stackable; conflicts are policy/readability rather than technical.

techniques.name: Model routing and cache economics
techniques.compatibility_rule: Can conflict with quality, privacy, and reproducibility policies.

techniques.name: Repository packing and digests
techniques.intervention_surface: whole-repository prompt packs and generated digests
techniques.compatibility_rule: Can conflict with targeted retrieval by encouraging over-ingestion.

techniques.name: Measurement and observability
techniques.compatibility_rule: Instrumentation is stackable; not a saving technique unless it changes behavior.

techniques.name: Benchmark and evaluation frameworks
techniques.intervention_surface: evaluation harnesses, validators, and token counters
techniques.compatibility_rule: Not a saving technique; used to compare techniques.
